# Support matrix

What CI is configured to exercise versus what is merely believed to work
(`docs/spec/08-distribution-and-project.md`, "Compatibility posture").
The floor is macOS 10.12 on Intel and 11.0 on Apple Silicon (ADR-0002); it
is asserted on every built artifact by `scripts/check-deployment-target.sh`.

> **The CI run on `main` this file names:** "Repository validation" passed
> at commit `ad5a95d` on 2026-10-21 (run 39578935218) on
> macos-26, macos-26-intel, macos-15 and macos-15-intel. That is one run of
> one commit; this table is not generated from runs. Every row describes
> configuration. Claiming tested support for an untested OS is the kind of
> dishonesty this project cannot afford
> (`docs/spec/08-distribution-and-project.md`), and a table that reads as
> evidence while being generated from labels is how that claim gets made
> without anyone deciding to make it.

| macOS | Intel x86_64 | Apple Silicon arm64 |
|---|---|---|
| 10.12 Sierra | best-effort | unsupported |
| 10.13 High Sierra | best-effort | unsupported |
| 10.14 Mojave | best-effort | unsupported |
| 10.15 Catalina | best-effort | unsupported |
| 11 Big Sur | best-effort | best-effort |
| 12 Monterey | best-effort | best-effort |
| 13 Ventura | best-effort | best-effort |
| 14 Sonoma | best-effort | best-effort |
| 15 Sequoia | tested | tested |
| 26 Tahoe | tested | tested |

- **tested**: a hosted runner with that macOS major and architecture is
  configured to run the full suite natively (`macos-26`, `macos-26-intel`, `macos-15`, `macos-15-intel`).
  Read that as configuration, not as evidence: this table is generated from
  the workflow's `runner:` labels and from nothing else, so it says what CI
  would run, not what any run reported.
- **best-effort**: the deployment floor is met and checked on the artifacts,
  and nothing executes there. macOS 10.12 to 10.15 have no hosted runner
  under GitHub's image policy (`docs/research/R-10-ci-runners.md`,
  read 2026-09-02); verification on real hardware is welcome.
- **unsupported**: below the floor.
